newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico plans $1 bln Cadereyta refinery expansion.
newsitem.headline: Mexico plans $1 bln Cadereyta refinery expansion.

text.p: Mexican Energy Minister Jesus Reyes Heroles said Tuesday that he hoped to have final approval for a $1 billion expansion of the country's Cadereyta oil refinery within 24 hours, and to publish an invitation to bid for the work on September 5.

"With regard to Cadereyta I have very good news," Reyes Heroles told legislators. "Yesterday the costs and financing committee approved the Cadereyta project...there will be important changes, there are about 10 additional installations to be built."
"It is an investment of more than $1 billion."
He said the board of state oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos would meet Wednesday to consider the project.
"If there are no problems with the board we would proceed with the publication of the invitation to bid in two days, that is to say on the fifth," he added.
No other details were immediately available.
